answer_1.quote: For the t-th turn, given historical context X_t, knowledge base K and a predicted action tuple \hat{a}_t, we aim to generate a coherent response \hat{Y}_t to the user.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses (text) aligned with predicted action tuples

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use perplexity (PPL), word-level F1 (F1), BLEU-N (N=1,2), Dist-N (N=1,2) and Knowledge F1 (Know. F1).

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 20 dialogues and invite two annotators to score those dialogues.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate turn-level aspects (Fluency, Proactivity, Informativeness) and dialogue-level aspects (Satisfaction, Coherency) using a 1-3 scale.
